metadata.title: Teachers Dictionary
metadata.description: Comprehensive shorthand codes for educators across school, college, and university levels

promptkit_dictionary.instructions_for_llm: These are shorthand codes that expand into full teaching instructions. When a user types a code followed by a colon and content, expand it into the full instruction for the AI to execute.
promptkit_dictionary.instructions_for_user: Use these codes with a colon (:) followed by your content. For example: 'lpl: Create a lesson plan for photosynthesis' becomes 'Create a comprehensive lesson plan for teaching photosynthesis'

Lesson Planning & Curriculum.description: Codes for creating lesson plans, curriculum development, and instructional design

usage_examples: lpl: World War II causes and effects
codes.instructions: Develop a detailed lesson plan including objectives, activities, materials, assessment, and timing
Create a comprehensive curriculum with learning objectives, modules, and progression

usage_examples: obj: Learners will analyze historical events
codes.instructions: Create clear, measurable learning objectives using Bloom's taxonomy

usage_examples: act: Group discussion on climate change
codes.instructions: Create interactive, student-centered learning activities that promote engagement

usage_examples: mat: For history lesson on ancient Rome
codes.instructions: Compile a comprehensive list of materials, resources, and equipment needed

codes.description: Get facts and data with citations and links
usage_examples: fact: Historical data on World War II
codes.instructions: Provide accurate facts, statistics, and data with proper citations, links to sources, and verification of information

codes.description: Create simple examples from day-to-day life
codes.instructions: Generate relatable, real-world examples that students can easily understand and connect to their daily experiences

codes.description: Simplify complex concepts for easy understanding
codes.instructions: Break down complex topics into simple, digestible explanations using analogies, metaphors, and step-by-step processes

Assessment & Evaluation.description: Codes for creating assessments, tests, rubrics, and evaluation methods

codes.description: Create a quiz or short assessment
codes.instructions: Design a quiz with multiple choice, true/false, and short answer questions
Develop a comprehensive exam with various question types and appropriate difficulty levels
Design a detailed rubric with clear criteria and performance levels

usage_examples: proj: Research project on renewable energy
codes.instructions: Create a project assignment with clear guidelines, deliverables, and evaluation criteria
Create peer assessment activities that promote collaborative learning

codes.description: Generate quiz and Q&A questions on given topic
usage_examples: qa: World War II Q&A session
codes.instructions: Create comprehensive quiz questions and Q&A sessions with varying difficulty levels, multiple question types, and answer keys

Classroom Management.description: Codes for classroom organization, behavior management, and student engagement

codes.instructions: Provide strategies for managing student behavior and maintaining classroom order
Suggest methods to increase student engagement and active participation
Design effective group work strategies and collaborative learning activities
Provide differentiated instruction strategies for diverse learners
Suggest time management strategies for effective classroom pacing
Create self-directed learning activities that students can complete independently during class time
Create engaging collaborative activities that promote teamwork, communication, and group learning
Create structured breakout activities for small groups to work on specific tasks or discussions

Communication & Feedback.description: Codes for parent communication, student feedback, and academic reporting

codes.instructions: Draft professional communication for parents regarding student progress and concerns
Write constructive, specific feedback that helps students improve
Create comprehensive academic reports with specific examples and recommendations
Draft compelling recommendation letters highlighting student strengths and achievements
Prepare talking points and materials for educational conferences and meetings

Professional Development.description: Codes for teacher training, professional growth, and educational research

codes.instructions: Create comprehensive training programs for professional development
Design research studies and analyze educational data for evidence-based practice
Guide reflective practice for continuous improvement in teaching
Create personalized professional development plans and learning objectives
Conduct systematic self-evaluation of teaching practices and outcomes

Technology Integration.description: Codes for incorporating technology into teaching and learning

codes.instructions: Suggest effective ways to integrate technology tools into classroom instruction
Create activities to develop students' digital literacy and responsible technology use
Design engaging online learning experiences and virtual classroom activities
Suggest appropriate educational technology tools and applications
Design blended learning experiences combining online and face-to-face instruction

Subject-Specific Teaching.description: Codes for specialized subject teaching strategies and content delivery

codes.instructions: Develop effective strategies for teaching mathematical concepts and problem-solving
Create engaging science lessons with hands-on experiments and inquiry-based learning
Develop language arts lessons focusing on reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills
Create engaging history lessons using primary sources and critical thinking activities
Design creative arts lessons that encourage self-expression and artistic development

Student Support.description: Codes for supporting student learning, well-being, and academic success

codes.instructions: Design personalized tutoring strategies for students who need additional support
Develop strategies to increase student motivation and academic engagement
Provide study skills instruction and learning strategy development
Offer career guidance and academic pathway planning for students
Address student mental health and well-being through supportive strategies

Administrative Tasks.description: Codes for administrative duties, record keeping, and institutional requirements

codes.instructions: Organize and maintain accurate student records and academic documentation
Provide fair, consistent grading with constructive feedback
Implement effective attendance tracking and participation management systems
Create organized schedules and timetables for effective time management
Plan and manage classroom budgets and educational resource allocation
